overview.zh-Hans: 该模块用于创建和管理阿里云SLB负载均衡实例。
overview.en-US: This module is used to create and manage Alibaba Cloud SLB (Server Load Balancer) instances.

description.zh-Hans: SLB负载均衡模块支持创建负载均衡实例、配置HTTP/HTTPS/TCP/UDP监听、挂载后端服务器、虚拟服务器组以及访问控制列表(ACL)和SSL证书。
description.en-US: The SLB module supports creating load balancer instances, configuring HTTP/HTTPS/TCP/UDP listeners, attaching backend servers, virtual server groups, access control lists (ACLs), and SSL certificates.
